title: YETI Pour Over Coffee Maker Accessory Ramblers, Designed for Perfect Coffee Extraction Anywhere, Stainless Steel, fits any V60 Filter, Black
reviews: This pour over works great, it stays cool enough on the outside that its easy to set aside after brewing. It's easy to clean, strong, and well constructed so it will be great to take camping or for traveling. It allows us to make microplastic free coffee. I bought the cone shaped filters, and I havent had any issues with them getting stuck or tearing. They just slide right out, no problem.
Really nice! Great size. Outside doesn’t get hot. Easy to clean. Coffee tasted great. Great for camping/hiking as it’s light.

It is a YETI so it is well made as expected. Almost the perfect pour over, though, if you have an oversized coffee cup, this is not the pour over for you. Works with most standard sized coffee cups as well as a host of YETI coffee cups. Goes in the dishwasher and comes out just like new. It is a little on the pricey side, but given the construction, you should never have to buy another.

A great product, with a few minor flaws. PROs: Double-walled so the outside doesn't get too hot to handle. The right size for larger Yeti Rambler mugs. Not too big and bulky. Not plastic, more durable than glass. Can clean in the dishwasher if you choose. I've retired my Chemex to the cupboard and use this instead. (Smaller, easier to use, cheaper filters, not breakable.) It lives on my kitchen counter next the Rambler mug I use throughout the day, a container of coffee beans, and a manual coffee grinder. It gets frequent use and I'm glad I purchased it. CONs: Expensive, like all Yeti products. Filters are harder to find in retail stores (but easily found online). Hard to see how much you are pouring into the mug, so it's easy to over-fill and spill hot coffee on the counter. Solutions: Use a kitchen scale to measure how much water you put in the kettle or how much water you are pouring into the mug. (400g water perfectly fills my Rambler mug.) Or, lift the dripper and see how much you still have to add. Or, with experience you will learn how often and how high you will have to fill up the cone. On mine, filling my mug seems to take dampening the grounds to let them "bloom" then filling the cone almost to the top two times. (Your mileage may vary.)

I got this YETI Pour Over for my husband for Christmas. Not only does it look cool, but it is super easy to use and works exactly as described. It keeps the coffee hot and he uses this every single weekend instead of his other coffee pot. He would use it on work days, but it does take a little time and he tends to sleep in. I would highly recommend this to anyone that is looking for a pour over coffee method.

Perfect for pour over coffee. We travel a lot & I didnt want to take my glass carafe so I purchased this. Yeti is my favorite cup (sorry Stanley) so this was a great addition. Strong, sturdy, and easy to clean. Great for travel.

Works great so far. Filters recommend fit as well. Solid, well built product like most Yeti products. I don’t know if I will ever use it camping, but works great if you are trying to move away from K-Cups and want a pretty fast option for one cup of coffee at a time.
So far, it’s worked as expected. Reviews about learning the process are reliable. Have a bit of patience, but it will deliver a great cup of coffee.
